privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary_device: All your cycle data stays on your device - no account, no server.
privacy.summary_no_sell: We never collect, sell, or share your personal data.
privacy.summary_sync: Any backup you make is encrypted before it leaves your device - we cannot read it.
privacy.summary_delete: Wipe your data in Settings, or delete the app, to erase everything permanently.
privacy.local_first: Luna is a local-first application. Personal data is stored exclusively on your device: in an encrypted local database on iOS and Android (SQLCipher) and in encrypted browser storage on the web (AES-256-GCM). There is no account, and Macaron Software holds zero knowledge of your data.
privacy.no_trackers: No cookies, analytics, advertising, or third-party trackers are used.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.point_tool: Luna is a personal cycle-tracking tool - not a contraceptive, not medical advice.
terms.point_data: Your data belongs to you; we have no access to it.
terms.point_free: Free to use; no subscription required.
terms.point_open_source: Open source under the MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses.
terms.body_no_advice: Luna does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and is not a method of contraception. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider for medical concerns.
terms.body_as_is: The app is provided as-is without warranties. Cycle predictions and fertile-window estimates may be inaccurate; Macaron Software is not liable for decisions made based on information recorded in the app.
